legacy_root.title: Niche, non-English, archival and policy-gated source sweep
legacy_root.question: Which orchestration mechanisms appear only in niche, non-English, archived or low-traffic sources — including lawful public onion sources under the opt-in policy — and does any of them survive corroboration against a mainstream surface?
legacy_root.answer: On the default path (onion class OFF) four orchestration mechanisms retrieved from non-English or archival public sources also appear on an independent mainstream surface and are recorded CORROBORATED: SOP-encoded role pipelines (Japanese practitioner + arXiv), durable HITL interrupt gates (Japanese practitioner + LangGraph docs), runtime manager allocation (Russian practitioner + CrewAI docs), the BabyAGI create/execute/prioritize loop (April 2023 post + IBM), and Contract Net bid-and-award (1980 paper + Wikipedia). One archival-only proposal — BabyAGI 'running parallel tasks' listed as future work — has no second-surface hit and stays UNVERIFIED. No onion-class source was fetched. Nothing from this sweep is a transaction, access-control bypass, stolen-data collection, or deanonymisation.

onion_source_class.policy: the onion source class stays OFF unless the owner explicitly enables it; the default path must run and report without it

findings.original_quote: 「Code = SOP(Team)」 SOPとは「Standardized Operating Procedures（標準作業手順）」のことで、企業や組織が効率的に機能するために定めたルールや業務フローのこと。MetaGPTは、このSOPをLLM（大規模言語モデル）へのプロンプトシーケンスとしてエンコードし、異なる専門役割を持つ複数のエージェントが協働する仕組みを構築している。
findings.translation: "Code = SOP(Team)". SOP means Standardized Operating Procedures: rules and workflows an organization sets so it can function efficiently. MetaGPT encodes those SOPs as prompt sequences for LLMs, building a mechanism in which multiple agents with different specialist roles collaborate.

findings.original_quote: Human-in-the-loop：処理の途中で人間が確認・修正できる。実際のビジネス要件では「このアクション、本当に実行してよいですか？」という人間の承認が必要になる。
findings.translation: Human-in-the-loop: a human can inspect and correct mid-run. Real business requirements need a human approval step of the form "may this action actually be executed?"

findings.mechanism: runtime manager agent allocating unassigned tasks
findings.original_quote: Crew поддерживает два фундаментально разных режима координации агентов: sequential и hierarchical. В hierarchical процессе появляется дополнительный слой управления — внутренний Manager агент. Этот менеджер сам анализирует все задачи и доступных агентов, затем принимает решения о распределении работы. Здесь уже можно не указывать кому накинуть задачку, решение будет принято в рантайме.
findings.translation: Crew supports two fundamentally different agent-coordination modes: sequential and hierarchical. In the hierarchical process an extra control layer appears — an internal Manager agent. That manager itself analyses every task and the available agents, then decides how to distribute the work. You no longer have to name who gets the task; the decision is taken at runtime.

findings.original_quote: the user provides an initial objective and task. An execution agent completes the task, a task creation agents creates follow-up tasks based on the result, and a prioritization agent adjusts the task list before sending the next task to the execution agent. We store task/result pairs in Pinecone as embedded vectors
findings.translation: the user provides an initial objective and task. An execution agent completes the task, a task-creation agent creates follow-up tasks based on the result, and a prioritization agent adjusts the task list before sending the next task to the execution agent.

findings.mechanism: parallel task execution as a proposed BabyAGI improvement
findings.original_quote: Some more core improvements to be made include adding safety/security measures, tracking task serialization, running parallel tasks, and adding a module to gather live updates such as checking emails and texts for new tasks and information.
findings.translation: Some more core improvements to be made include adding safety/security measures, tracking task serialization, running parallel tasks, and adding a module to gather live updates such as checking emails and texts for new tasks and information.

findings.original_quote: available contractors evaluate task announcements made by several managers and submit bids on those for which they are suited. The managers evaluate the bids and award contracts to the nodes they determine to be most appropriate.
findings.translation: available contractors evaluate task announcements made by several managers and submit bids on those for which they are suited. The managers evaluate the bids and award contracts to the nodes they determine to be most appropriate.
